method: Actual ChapterOneEndingScreen host and three transition overlay trees from one real five-area App host route. Each is drawn at 320×568/fontScale2, 390×844/1.5 and 430×932/1 using native styles translated to browser CSS. Ending top/bottom and transition action/text rectangles are captured. The App host used memory AsyncStorage and stub native Canvas/audio; this is not native Yoga, VoiceOver focus, safe-area or iPhone screenshot evidence.
